blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Elgin Chantrell, October 2026. Detached houses: 74 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 16 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 38 sold over 5 months against an average of 77.8 listed, about 10.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 10 sold over 5 months against an average of 11.8 listed, about 5.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 4 sold.

blocks.text: Estate and acreage country that still feels rural, even inside city limits: that’s Elgin Chantrell. The space is the main attraction, and most of the families I talk to have Chantrell Creek Elementary and Elgin Park Secondary in mind.

These are the 8 closest neighbourhoods we cover to the centre point we use for Elgin Chantrell in South Surrey, nearest first. Distances are straight-line between centre points, so the drive is longer.

faq.a: No — it is a Paragon (MLS) board sub-area name combining two local names, Elgin and Chantrell Creek. The City of Surrey publishes no single boundary for "Elgin Chantrell" and uses the two local names separately, as does the school district.
faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell an official City of Surrey neighbourhood?

faq.a: Elgin Heritage Park on Crescent Road — a City-designated heritage site at the Historic Stewart Farm (Stewart Farmhouse, 13723 Crescent Road) on the Nicomekl River — and Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, a 140-hectare second-growth forest at 2598 144 Street with about four kilometres of nature trails including the 0.8-km Wally Ross universal access trail.

At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 74 houses listed with 8 sold in the month and 16 condos and townhomes listed with 2 sold in the month in Elgin Chantrell. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Elgin Chantrell?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 13%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
